title: Intermediate existence of transported derived restriction data
statement: For compatible ring equivalences and universal derived scalar extensions, every termwise scalar-extension isomorphism admits a derived restriction functor and localization factorization isomorphism.

proof.text: Use the official upstream ModuleCat.exists_raw_transport. It constructs the exact restriction-of-scalars functor on derived categories and composes mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh, whiskered by the homotopy quotient, with mapHomotopyCategoryFactors, whiskered by DerivedCategory.Qh. This gives the functor E and a Nonempty localization factorization isomorphism. The original more specialized statement follows by unpacking Nonempty and adjoining True; all R-side, scalar-extension, compatibility and termwise-isomorphism data are unused.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_raw_transport {B₀ B : Type u} [CommRing B₀] [CommRing B]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} B₀)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (ModuleCat.{u} B)]
    (eB : B₀ ≃+* B) :
    let S₀ := HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} B₀) (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh
    let S := HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} B) (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh
    let U := restrictScalars.{u} eB.toRingHom
    ∃ E : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} B) ⥤ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} B₀),
      Nonempty (S ⋙ E ≅ U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ S₀)
lean.note: Retired the unused Sheaf copy in favor of the official upstream twin (human retirement hand-off, 2026-10-20). The upstream theorem drops unused R-side, derived-extension and termwise-isomorphism parameters, and packages the factorization isomorphism with Nonempty. It implies the entire original statement: after introducing the original lets and t, obtain ⟨E, ⟨q⟩⟩ := exists_raw_transport eB and return ⟨E, q, trivial⟩. The sole DAG parent already imports and applies the upstream theorem.
